name: Ula'elek and the Brutal Gauntlets
label: Quest
description: Thun'grim Firegaze sends you from the Barrens to Sen'jin Village for the Brutal Gauntlets. There, Darkspear craftsman Ula'elek will forge them.

clips.title: The story
paras: Thun'grim Firegaze sends you from the Barrens to Sen'jin Village for the Brutal Gauntlets. There, Darkspear craftsman Ula'elek will forge them.

Thun'grim Firegaze sends you east after you prove your valor in the Barrens and begin assembling the Brutal Armor set. The veteran orc smith relies on skilled artisans across Horde lands instead of forging every piece at his mountain perch. For the heavy mail gauntlets, he directs you to Durotar's rocky southern shores.

In Sen'jin Village, troll armorsmith Ula'elek works among his Darkspear kin. Thun'grim has already told him of your deeds, and Ula'elek says the spirits have watched your triumphs in battle. For a warrior earning a place among the Horde's elite, fine craft and spiritual acknowledgement go hand in hand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The troll smith Ula'elek will craft for you the brutal gauntlets. He dwells in Durotar, in Sen'jin Village with his Darkspear brethren, and he awaits your coming.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, friend. Old Thun'grim sent word to me of your coming, but had he kept silent your presence here would not have surprised me.
The spirits follow your progress, young adventurer, and they tell me that many foes have fallen before you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
